history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A lone hiker stands leaning against a gnarled, ancient tree trunk on a mountain peak. The hiker, seen from the chest up, wears a dark, possibly black, windbreaker or jacket over a backpack, and dark pants. Their hand is raised to their head, perhaps scratching their scalp or shielding their eyes from the sun. Their dark, medium-length hair partially obscures their face. They are holding a trekking pole in their right hand, gripping it firmly near the top.

The tree itself is a prominent feature, with a thick, rough, and weathered trunk that splits into several branches. The bark is a rich brown, showing signs of age and texture. The branches are mostly bare, with sparse clusters of dry, yellowing leaves catching the sunlight. To the right of the main tree, a smaller, more slender tree with feathery foliage is visible.

The background is a breathtaking vista of rolling mountains and mist. Two distinct volcanic peaks are visible in the distance, silhouetted against a soft, hazy horizon. The sky is a clear, pale blue, transitioning to a warmer, yellowish hue near the horizon, suggesting either sunrise or sunset. The overall mood is one of solitude, adventure, and awe-inspiring natural beauty. The lighting is warm and golden, casting long shadows and highlighting the textures of the tree and the landscape. The color palette is dominated by earthy browns, deep greens, soft blues, and warm yellows. The style is photographic and realistic, capturing the grandeur of the mountain scenery and the quiet moment of the hiker.
